name: hansgrohe
verdict: Hansgrohe SE is 68% owned by the US-listed Masco Corporation; the Klaus Grohe family holds 32%. Nothing found.
note: German sanitary-fittings manufacturer. Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): Masco is NYSE-listed and the holders above 5% in its 2026 proxy statement are US fund managers (Vanguard, BlackRock, Harris Associates); no state in the chain, and no human-rights finding against Hansgrohe or Masco found.
